method: Each group's range [low, high] is the range given by the cited source, or the min-max of the cited per-kg dealer listings (obvious errors removed). No estimates are made by us. The ranking uses the midpoint of the range; the user sees the range. Groups with no source have low/high = null and show 'Price not available - enter your price'. The user can enter their own price for any group (used only for that request; this file is never changed).

carbon_steel.label: Carbon / structural steel
carbon_steel.source: OfBusiness mild steel prices (HR coil 52-55, TMT 52-58, CR coil 58-66, E250 angle 58)
carbon_steel.why: Plain carbon steel is the cheapest engineering metal: high-volume production from iron ore with few alloying additions.

alloy_steel.label: Low-alloy steel (Cr, Mo, Ni)
alloy_steel.source: IndiaMART alloy steel listings: 4140 Rs 81, EN19 Rs 88-100, EN24 Rs 90-160
alloy_steel.why: Costs more than carbon steel because of added chromium, molybdenum and nickel, which allow hardening and higher strength.

free_cutting_steel.label: Free-cutting steel
free_cutting_steel.source: IndiaMART free cutting steel listings: EN1A Rs 71-90, leaded EN1A Rs 60, 12L14 Rs 65
free_cutting_steel.why: Carbon steel with added sulphur/lead for easy machining; priced close to plain carbon steel.

spring_steel.label: Spring steel
spring_steel.source: IndiaMART spring steel listings: EN47/50CrV4 Rs 85-300, EN42J Rs 100-170
spring_steel.why: Alloyed with silicon/chromium/vanadium and often supplied hardened and tempered; tempered strip sits at the top of the range.

stainless_austenitic.label: Stainless steel, austenitic (304 type)
stainless_austenitic.source: OfBusiness stainless price summary: SS 304 Rs 180-220/kg
stainless_austenitic.why: Contains about 18% chromium and 8% nickel; nickel is expensive, so 304 costs about 3x carbon steel.

stainless_mo.label: Stainless steel, Mo-bearing (316 type)
stainless_mo.source: OfBusiness stainless price summary: SS 316 Rs 280-350/kg
stainless_mo.why: Like 304 but with more nickel and 2-3% molybdenum for chloride resistance, which raises the price.

stainless_ferritic.label: Stainless steel, ferritic/martensitic (4xx)
stainless_ferritic.why: Chromium stainless with little or no nickel, so it is the cheapest stainless family.

heat_resistant_steel.label: Heat-resistant steel
heat_resistant_steel.source: IndiaMART SS 310/310S listings Rs 380-1,000/kg (most sheets Rs 380-500)
heat_resistant_steel.why: High chromium-nickel grades (e.g. 310: 25% Cr, 20% Ni) for high temperature; the high nickel content makes them expensive.

grey_cast_iron.label: Grey cast iron (castings)
grey_cast_iron.source: IndiaMART / TradeIndia CI casting listings Rs 65-115/kg (price of finished casting per kg)
grey_cast_iron.why: Cheap iron poured straight into moulds; price is per kg of finished casting, so it includes the casting process.

ductile_iron.label: Ductile / malleable iron (castings)
ductile_iron.source: TradeIndia SG iron casting listings Rs 80-120/kg
ductile_iron.why: Cast iron treated with magnesium for toughness; slightly dearer than grey iron castings.

cast_steel.label: Cast steel (castings)
cast_steel.why: Steel casting needs higher melting temperature than iron, so castings cost more than cast iron.

stainless_cast.label: Stainless cast steel (castings)
stainless_cast.source: IndiaMART stainless / investment casting listings Rs 325-500/kg
stainless_cast.why: Stainless alloy cost plus casting cost.

aluminium_wrought.label: Aluminium alloy, wrought (1xxx/3xxx/5xxx/6xxx)
aluminium_wrought.source: IndiaMART 6061/6063 rod listings Rs 200-425/kg; aluminium spot Rs 338/kg (BankBazaar, 9 Oct 2026)
aluminium_wrought.why: Priced close to the aluminium metal price plus extrusion/rolling; about 3x lighter than steel, so less mass per part.

aluminium_high_strength.label: Aluminium alloy, high strength (2xxx/7xxx)
aluminium_high_strength.source: IndiaMART aluminium rod listings for 2xxx/7xxx grades Rs 300-999/kg
aluminium_high_strength.why: Aerospace grades with copper/zinc additions and tighter processing; sold at a premium over common aluminium.

aluminium_cast.label: Aluminium casting alloy
aluminium_cast.source: IndiaMART aluminium alloy ingot listings: ADC12 Rs 170-340, LM6 Rs 195-222, LM25 Rs 230
aluminium_cast.why: Casting ingot (often from recycled aluminium) is cheaper than wrought bar; price is for ingot, before casting.

copper.label: Copper / high-copper alloy
copper.source: Copper spot Rs 1,423/kg (BankBazaar, 9 Oct 2026); fabricated forms cost more
copper.why: Pure copper is one of the most expensive common metals; only the spot price is available, so rod/sheet will cost somewhat more.

beryllium_copper.label: Beryllium copper
beryllium_copper.why: Copper with about 2% beryllium, a costly and specially handled element; used where very high strength copper is needed.

brass.label: Brass
brass.source: IndiaMART brass rod listings Rs 400-875/kg (IS 319, free-cutting, CZ122). Note: likely stale, as brass is ~60-70% copper and copper spot is Rs 1,423/kg
brass.why: Copper-zinc alloy; cheaper than pure copper because zinc is cheaper. Listings look out of date, so check with a supplier.

bronze.label: Bronze (tin, phosphor, aluminium, manganese, silicon)
bronze.source: IndiaMART phosphor bronze rod listings Rs 680-1,500/kg (aluminium bronze Rs 600-2,000)
bronze.why: Mostly copper with tin or aluminium; tin is expensive, so bronze usually costs more than brass.

copper_nickel.label: Copper-nickel / nickel silver
copper_nickel.source: IndiaMART cupro-nickel 90/10 and 70/30 pipe listings Rs 600-1,500/kg
copper_nickel.why: Copper with 10-30% nickel; excellent in sea water, priced near or above copper.

magnesium_alloy.label: Magnesium alloy (AZ/AM/ZK)
magnesium_alloy.source: IndiaMART magnesium alloy listings: AM50 Rs 550, AZ91D block Rs 1,600
magnesium_alloy.why: Lightest structural metal; small Indian market, so prices vary widely between suppliers.

magnesium_re.label: Magnesium alloy, rare-earth (WE/ZE/QE/EZ/HK/HM)
magnesium_re.source: No reliable Indian listing found (only one placeholder listing)
magnesium_re.why: Specialty aerospace magnesium alloys with rare-earth elements; not commonly stocked in India.
